description:
Tassili Detectives: five Algerian students blending AI, data engineering, geospatial analysis and design to turn raw data into clear insight. We chose this challenge: time-series, climate and energy systems, and storytelling.

Assil: AI/full-stack dev, UI/UX, MedVision AI founder.

Manar: Energy Physics & AI, computer vision, NLP.

Mehdi: full-stack & GIS (PostGIS), RAG/LLM.

Hacen: backend, data pipelines, RAG.

Rania: front-end, UI/UX, researcher.

Hackathon winners shipping real products.
